programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars: Robert Newton, Sally Gray & Phil Brown. A cuckolded psychiatrist kidnaps his wife's lover and hides him away while he plans his revenge.

programme.title: Open Fire
programme.desc: 1994. Crime. Directed by Paul Greengrass. Stars Rupert Graves, Kate Hardie & Jim Carter. A compelling drama capturing the life of one of Britain's most wanted men during the 1980s - David Martin.

programme.title: Panic in Year Zero
programme.desc: 1962. Sci-fi. Directed by & stars Ray Milland. Featuring Jean Hagan & Frankie Avalon. A family must fight to survive in the lawless aftermath of a nuclear disaster in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Hammer The Toff
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama by Maclean Rogers. The Toff (John Bentley) tries to help Susan (Patricia Dainton) reunite with her uncle who's been targeted by criminals that are after his steel formula.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The Frontier Theatre. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Angela Greene, Fay Roope. Wyatt closes down an all-girl show when the women begin stealing from the audience. The owner plots to get even with Earp.

programme.title: The Westerner
programme.desc: Dos Pinos. 1962. Stars: Brian Keith, Spike & Hank Gobble. Dave and Brown arrive in the town of Dos Pinos looking for room and board.

programme.title: Send For Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Directed by John Argyle. Starring Anthony Hulme and Joy Shelton. Scotland Yard calls in novelist and amateur detective Paul Temple to help track down a gang of diamond robbers.

programme.title: Steam Beyond the Solent
programme.desc: 1966. An enchanting film about the Solent with a look at the magnificent steam trains operating across the Isle of Wight.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Kingfishers and Corn Flail. 1981. Jack joins David Boag as he trains rescued kingfishers to catch minnows. He then witnesses how corn was threshed before the days of the combine harvester.

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars June Thorburn, Pete Murray & Soraya Rafat. Barbara Winters hires beatnik Stanford as her chief fashion adviser which leads to comedic complications.

programme.title: Devil Girl From Mars
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by David MacDonald. Stars Patricia Laffan, Hugh McDermott & Hazel Court. A female alien, accompanied by a menacing robot, comes to Earth to collect men as breeding stock.

programme.title: Fuel Limerick Share Your Fire
programme.desc: 1942. Narrated by Barry Cyer. A charming short limerick about sharing your fireside to save fuel!

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: Reunion. 1976. Stars Bill Dean, Glynn Edwards & Jack Warner. Twenty years ago, a number of police officers were involved in a major operation at the Docks and now it's time for them to reunite.

programme.title: Cottage to Let
programme.desc: 1941. War. Director: Anthony Asquith. Stars Leslie Banks, Alastair Sim & John Mills. Nazi spies learn about a new device created by a British inventor and send an undercover agent to his cottage.

programme.title: Life In Danger
programme.desc: 1959. Crime thriller directed by Terry Bishop and stars Derren Nesbitt. A child murderer escapes from an asylum.

programme.title: The Girl On The Pier
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars Veronica Hurst, Ron Randell & Marjorie Rhodes. Rivalry between a Brighton crooner who has done time and his partner in crime, who is being blackmailed.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Game for Three Losers. 1965. Directed by Gerry O'Hara. Stars Michael Gough, Mark Eden & Toby Robins. Happily married, Hilary still lets his desire for his new secretary get the better of him.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse
programme.desc: Drama. 1955. Director: Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer, Beverly Garland & Mimi Gibson. A woman trapped in a cottage during a storm discovers that an escaped convict is on his way to kill her.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Puzzles are Coming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Puzzler tries to fool Knab while the Dynamic Duo hunt the truth, but The Puzzler plans to stop their search.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Radioactive. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Peter Bowie & Terry Dickinson. Jack Bane and his two accomplices steal a car for a robbery, which unexpectedly sets off an extraordinary chain of events.

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1969. The Investors. Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard, John Le Mesuriere & Mona Bruce. Twelve people - all private income - have disappeared from London over a period of twelve months.

programme.title: The Strange Case of Sherlock...
programme.desc: ...Holmes and Arthur Conan Doyle. 2005. Drama. Director: Cilla Ware. Stars Douglas Henshall, Brian Cox & Emily Blunt. The story of Conan Doyle's remarkable life and the birth of Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro welcomes all her cellar dwelling friends back for a night of fascinating films. First, is the 1962 horror The Cabinet of Caligari starring the late Glynis Johns, with Dan O'Herlihy.

programme.title: The Cabinet of Caligari
programme.desc: 1962. Horror. Directed by Roger Kay. Stars Glynis Johns, Dan O'Herlihy & Richard Davalos. A girl becomes trapped in the mysterious estate of Dr. Caligari after seeking help to repair a flat tyre.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next up is a fast-paced horror film with plenty of typical 1980s ingredients. Caroline Munro introduces the 1982 feature Mortuary, starring Mary McDonough and David Wallace.

programme.title: Mortuary
programme.desc: 1982. Horror. Directed by Howard Avedis. Stars Mary Beth McDonough, David Wysocki & Bill Paxton. Convinced that her father's death was not an accident, a young woman decides to investigate.
